title: CrewAI Project Creation
summary: This module facilitates the creation of new CrewAI projects by copying template files and provides a blueprint for defining a sample content generation crew with agents and tasks.

nodes.label: Trigger Project Creation
nodes.title: CLI Project Creation
nodes.description: User initiates the creation of a new CrewAI project via a command-line interface command, typically through the CrewAI CLI.

nodes.label: Copy Project Template Files
nodes.title: Template File Copying
nodes.description: Copies a set of predefined template files, including project structure, configuration, and sample crew definitions, into the newly designated project directory.

nodes.label: Provide Content Crew Blueprint
nodes.title: Content Crew Template
nodes.description: Defines a foundational structure for a content generation crew, including methods for defining agents and tasks, and assembling the final crew instance.

nodes.label: Load Agent/Task Configurations
nodes.title: YAML Configuration Loading
nodes.description: Reads agent and task definitions from external YAML configuration files (e.g., agents.yaml, tasks.yaml) to parameterize the crew's components dynamically.

nodes.label: Define Crew Agents
nodes.title: Agent Definition
nodes.description: Specifies the roles, capabilities, and configurations for individual AI agents (e.g., planner, writer, editor) within the crew, based on loaded configurations.

nodes.label: Define Crew Tasks
nodes.title: Task Definition
nodes.description: Outlines the specific tasks (e.g., planning, writing, editing) that agents will perform, including their objectives, dependencies, and expected outputs.

nodes.label: Build Crew Instance
nodes.title: Crew Assembly
nodes.description: Assembles the defined agents and tasks into a cohesive CrewAI crew, ready for execution with a specified process flow and verbose logging.

groups.label: CLI Interface
groups.title: Command Line Interface
groups.description: Handles user interaction for initiating new project creation through command-line commands.

groups.label: Project Scaffolding
groups.title: New Project Generation
groups.description: Manages the creation of new CrewAI project directories and populates them with initial template files and basic structure.

groups.label: Crew Definition
groups.title: Crew Blueprint & Assembly
groups.description: Provides the template for defining a CrewAI crew, including its agents and tasks, and orchestrates their assembly into a functional unit.

groups.label: Configuration Data
groups.title: Crew Configuration Files
groups.description: External YAML files that store the detailed configurations for agents and tasks, allowing for flexible and declarative crew setup.
